records.name: FSC10214+4724

note.before: Pending reference review: The 1991 reference reports the infrared object. First identification as a gravitational lens remains to be established.
note.after: Rowan-Robinson 1991 discovers the infrared object, not its lens nature. Matthews 1994 is the earliest located explicit lens hypothesis, which those authors disfavor; Elston 1994 gives a positive possible-magnification interpretation. Broadhurst & Lehar 1995 and Graham & Liu 1995 supply lens/counterimage evidence; Eisenhardt 1996 adds HST confirmation (preprint 1995). Do not treat the 1994 hypothesis as confirmation.
